environment.description: Same application on Ubuntu 22.04 ECS Fargate task (linux/amd64, platform version 1.4.0). Task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with a single tmpfs volume mounted at /var/lib/app/uploads (size 64MB, mount options: noexec,nosuid,nodev). The ECS task execution role has no additional permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs. The task role has zero attached policies (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/app-task-role with empty permission set). Container runs as non-root user 1000 with linuxParameters.capabilities.drop set to ALL and linuxParameters.capabilities.add containing only NET_BIND_SERVICE. Fargate platform version 1.4.0 enforces the default seccomp profile which blocks execve-family calls from forked children when the parent process has CAP_SYS_ADMIN dropped (which it is, since all caps are dropped). Additionally, the tmpfs noexec mount flag prevents execution of any binaries written to the uploads directory.
